sizing_context: Historical case: Druckenmiller built a very large Deutsche mark position over a few days because he believed the market had misread the policy reaction function after the Berlin Wall fell.
sizing_principle: Special-situation macro sizing: when a major policy shock causes the market to price the first-order fiscal effect but not the central-bank reaction function, the trade can be sized aggressively if liquidity is deep and invalidation is clear.
risk_capacity_notes: This is not a generic rule to buy currencies after deficits rise. It depends on a credible anti-inflation central bank, liquid FX expression, and the deficit shock increasing rather than reducing expected relative rates.
human_notes: This eval is historical and should teach reaction-function reasoning, not hindsight outcome chasing.
